title: Mister Miracle (DC Comics, 2019) – Tom King & Mitch Gerads – Eisner Award Winner
descriptionText:
Condition: Excellent — minimal shelf wear, tight spine, and clean pages (see photos).
Description:
Winner of multiple Eisner Awards for Best Writer and Best Artist, Mister Miracle is one of the most acclaimed modern superhero graphic novels. Written by Tom King (Batman, Vision) and illustrated by Mitch Gerads, this 12-issue limited series redefines one of Jack Kirby’s most iconic characters in a profound, psychological exploration of heroism, trauma, and escape.
The story follows Scott Free, the world’s greatest escape artist, as he faces the ultimate trap — life itself. This Eisner Award–winning series is a must-read for collectors and fans of modern DC storytelling.
Details:
Title: Mister Miracle
Publisher: DC Comics
Publication Year: 2019
Format: Trade Paperback
Writer: Tom King
Artist: Mitch Gerads
ISBN: 978-1-4012-8354-4
Cover Price: $24.99 USD / $33.99 CAD
Collects: Mister Miracle #1–12 (complete series)
Awards: Eisner Award Winner – Best Writer & Best Artist
Suggested for: Mature Readers
Condition Notes: Excellent overall; very light wear on cover edge (see detailed photos).
